full:
Please create ONE new image based on the attached reference sheet.

The sheet has 3 numbered panels. All people shown are AI-generated, fictional adult characters, used only as character-design references.
Panel 1 · POSE: Line-art mannequin. Use only the body pose, weight balance, hand gestures and camera viewpoint, and keep the same framing. Do not draw mannequin lines or joints.
Panel 2 · OUTFIT: Use only the clothing, footwear and accessories: their design, colors, materials and how they are worn. Ignore the display stand, the layout and any model wearing them.
Panel 3 · CHARACTER DESIGN: Use this character design for face shape, facial features, hairstyle, hair color and skin tone. Ignore this panel's pose, clothing and crop.

Result: one single adult character, fully clothed, wearing the outfit from Panel 2, in the pose from Panel 1, with the character design from Panel 3. Let the fabric drape naturally with the pose. Plain, simple background. Match the overall visual style of the references. Vertical 2:3 framing.
Avoid: text, logos, watermarks, borders, collages, split screens, extra views or extra people. Do not reproduce the reference sheet itself.
